As published on 26 November 2026.

## Constant powers in ideals generated by distinguished series

[Theorem PHT.1085](https://andrewodesky.com/rh/lean/Formalism.ExponentWindows.E.word_constants_holds/)

Let $O$ be a discrete valuation domain, $\varpi$ an irreducible element, $\ell\ge2$ and $q\ge0$ integers. Let $p_s\in O[[X]]$, $s\ge0$, satisfy: for every $s<q$, $p_s$ is a unit times a monic polynomial of degree $\ell^s$ whose lower coefficients lie in $(\varpi)$; and for distinct $s,t<q$, there are $a,b\in O[[X]]$ and $N\ge0$ with $ap_s+bp_t=\varpi^N$. Let $b_s\ge0$ be arbitrary integers.

For $s_0<s_1<q$, the ideal $J=(p_{s_1}^{b_{s_1}},p_{s_0}^{b_{s_0}})$ contains a least power $\varpi^\rho$ among the nonnegative powers of $\varpi$. There is $f_\rho\in(p_{s_1}^{b_{s_1}})$ such that $f_\rho-\varpi^\rho\in(p_{s_0}^{b_{s_0}})$. If $b_{s_0}\ge1$, there exist $c\ge0$ and $\alpha,\beta\in O[[X]]$ with $$p_{s_1}^{b_{s_1}}=\varpi^c\alpha+p_{s_0}^{b_{s_0}}\beta,\qquad p_{s_1}^{b_{s_1}}\notin(\varpi^{c+1},p_{s_0}^{b_{s_0}}).$$
